risks.risk: Engine identification mismatch (wrong engine code/variant for the buyer’s car). The photo label is not readable enough to confirm exact model/variant.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the engine code/variant stamping (e.g., on engine block/plate) and the full engine nameplate, plus a photo of the VIN/fitment info if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used engine with unknown exact variant (worst-case fitment risk).

risks.risk: Not actually tested to running condition (could be sold as 'tested ok' but not truly verified).
risks.proof: Request a short video clip of the engine running (cold start if possible) showing stable idle and no abnormal noise, plus a video of the gauge readings if any.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven running (worst-case: treat as needs further verification).

risks.risk: Internal wear/damage not visible (compression, head gasket, timing chain/belt condition).
risks.proof: Request compression test results (or leak-down test) screenshot/photo, or at least a mechanic’s test report with readings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially worn/unknown internal condition.

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories or incomplete assembly (alternator, starter, sensors, ECU, intake/exhaust components).
risks.proof: Ask for a full inventory photo: both sides of the engine, and close-ups of all sensors/connectors and what is included/excluded.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the engine code/variant stamping and any label that identifies the exact engine (so we can match to the comparables).
Video of the engine running (start + 2–3 minutes idle) showing no knock and stable operation.
Compression/leak-down test results (photo/screenshot) or a mechanic’s written report with readings.
Photos showing what accessories are included (starter, alternator, sensors, ECU/ignition components) and what is not.
response.reason: The photo shows an engine, but the exact engine code/variant and key proof of 'tested ok/low mileage/never opened' are not verifiable from the single image. Without identification, a correct worst-case price pick from the comparables is not reliable.
